source_evidence: — Anna Mani Lambok and his elder sister Phiban live in Shillong.
Their parents were away at work and Lambok complained that he was feeling feverish.
Phiban touched his forehead and felt that he might be having a fever.
To confirm this, she took out the thermometer kept in the almirah.
